events.text: Andrey Santos (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ayden Heaven (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for dangerous play.

Goal! Manchester United 0, Bournemouth 1. Rayan (Bournemouth) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Justin Kluivert with a cross following a set piece situation.
Youri Tielemans (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Manchester United 0, Bournemouth 2. Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Adrien Truffert.
Harry Maguire (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Manchester United. Matheus Cunha replaces Youri Tielemans.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Ben Gannon-Doak replaces Justin Kluivert.
Substitution, Manchester United. Lisandro Martínez replaces Ayden Heaven.
Goal! Manchester United 0, Bournemouth 3. Evanilson (Bournemouth) right footed shot from a difficult angle and long range on the right to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Lewis Cook.
Substitution, Manchester United. Joshua Zirkzee replaces Carlos Baleba.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Ryan Christie replaces Lewis Cook.
Substitution, Manchester United. Shea Lacey replaces Amad Diallo.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Amine Adli replaces Marcus Tavernier.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Junior Kroupi replaces Evanilson.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Bafodé Diakité replaces Adam Smith.
Second Half ends, Manchester United 0, Bournemouth 3.
